3. INSPECT FLOW CONTROL VALVE
(a) Coat the flow control valve with power steering fluid and
check that it falls smoothly into the valve hole of the front
housing by its own weight.
(b) Check the flow control valve for leakage. C!ose one of the Compressed Air holes and apply compressed air of 392 - 490 kPa (4 - 5
kgf/cm2, 57 - 71 psi) into the opposite side hole, and con­
firm that air does not come out from the end hole.
